title: 第29章 嗑你的瓜子
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
下午酉时。

    云航镇，西街区，宝昌街六号院。

    夕阳从西面的院墙上斜斜漫过来，将满院子的青石板染成一片暖金色。

    苏牧斜躺在竹椅上，手指无意识地摩挲着茶杯杯沿，目光时不时扫向拱门。

    结果没等到沈南初的出现，楚阳倒是先来了。

    他看着对方一步步走到面前，盯着问：“人呢？”

    楚阳在旁入座，顺手从案几上翻了只空杯，给自己倒了杯茶，端起来抿了一口，才不紧不慢道：“走了，两个时辰前，她说想通了，让我转告你，祝你婚姻幸福美满。”

    苏牧等了会没有下文，狐疑问：“没了？这么温和？”

    楚阳对视好笑道：“没了，就这一句，我还能骗大哥不成？”

    苏牧挑了下眉，脸色古怪道：“想通了？你信么？从清晨到现在五、六个时辰，她跑哪去了？怎么突然就想通了？不找来咬我两口，高低得骂上几十句！”

    楚阳耸了耸肩，咧嘴道：“我也不信，但她就是这么说的，说在坊市转悠了一圈，觉得没意思，突然想通了，不过她祝福你的时候，嘴角笑得不对劲，一看就没好事，反正人是真的走了，我看着她下山，在路口守了一个多时辰，没见她偷偷溜回来。”

    苏牧沉吟片刻，又问：“说去哪没？”

    楚阳摇头道：“没有，说浪迹天涯，随遇而安，走到哪算哪，还说什么有缘自会再见，这些是一大早离开时说的……哦，对了！”

    说着，他往腰间摸去，从储物袋里取出一个大兽皮袋搁在地上，袋底落在青石板上发出沉闷的声响。

    “七百灵石，也是一早让我转交给你的，后来在山头没等到你去送她，她又突然掉头，很气愤的样子，我以为她要找大哥撒泼，便传讯提醒…再就是未时左右重新出现，走得很干脆。”

    苏牧低头看向脚边的兽皮袋，抿唇沉默。

    楚阳看了他一眼，拿起茶壶添茶，嘴角憋着一丝笑意道：“我问了，她存了一千三百多积蓄，和你一人一半，我想替你拒绝，她硬塞给我，说可怜你这个垃圾菜鸟，就当喂了狗了……咳~大哥，我可都是原话转述的。”

    苏牧踢脚作势踹去，笑骂道：“滚！”

    却不小心牵动伤口，‘嘶’了一声，转而缓缓吐了口气，收起玩笑，轻叹一声道：“将来若有机会，我百倍还她！”

    楚阳轻轻点头，笑了笑道：“刚来的路上，我一直在想，这个结果也挺好，南初姐那么聪明机灵，在外面一般也很难被人欺负到，若是留下，以前大哥单身还好，如今与齐师妹在一起了，以南初姐的脾气，多瞧见几次，估计要心态爆炸，搞不好真会整出什么大麻烦来。”

    苏牧会心一笑，脑海中浮现沈南初叉腰骂人的画面。

    思绪飞了会，他以眼神示意地上的袋子，道：“这七百灵石也放你那，妖兽种类越多越好，珍惜品种也要，两千块肯定不够。”

    楚阳跟着看去一眼道：“我正要跟大哥说呢，你应该不急着用吧，商铺里的妖兽和材料都太贵，不划算，我接了任务去外面猎杀捕捉。”

    苏牧问：“去哪？多长时间？”

    楚阳道：“万兽山，后天动身，来回怎么也得八、九个月，运气好的话可能快一点，完了回来我再去其它坊市转一圈，基本就够大哥炼体入门了。”

    不等再问，他主动细说情况道：“这次主要任务是找‘百花灵蛇草’和二阶‘穿云雕’，万兽山外围就有，我们五个人组队，一个筑基中期四层，剩下和我一样筑基三层，都是熟人，也不是第一次去，任务难度适中。”

    苏牧正色道：“那也得注意安全，多些谨慎小心，凡事多留个心眼。”

    楚阳笑道：“知道，大哥放心。”

    苏牧微微颔首道：“那这七百灵石放我这，一会留下吃饭，尝尝你嫂子的手艺。”

    话音落下，长廊传来脚步声，齐云溪微低着脑袋，脚步比平时慢了几分，一副心事重重的样子，走到近前方才察觉院中多了个人。

    楚阳却先站起了身，拱手招呼道：“齐师妹。”

    魂游天外的齐云溪愣了愣，连忙还礼道：“楚师兄！”

    跟着她朝苏牧挤出一个笑脸，便迈开步子往屋里跑去，入门之际又扭头看了二人一眼，心中狐疑，一个内门筑基期弟子居然主动与自己行礼招呼，以前都没这般客气，只点头致意。

    这边，楚阳忍不住传音道：“大哥，齐师妹有点呆啊，这么弱，以后你要办点什么事，她都帮不上忙，比南初姐可差太多了。”

    苏牧嘴角一扯，翻了个白眼过去。

    少顷，齐溪云端着一张小圆桌出来，放到二人面前，然后从储物袋里往桌上摆灵果、糕点、瓜子等各种吃食，跟着又拿了茶壶去厨房，重新泡了一壶新茶，替二人续上。
content_en:
You time in the afternoon.

    Yunhang Town, West Street District, No. 6 Baochang Street.

    The setting sun slanted over the west courtyard wall, dyeing the bluestone slabs all over the courtyard a warm golden color.

    Su Mu was lying on the bamboo chair, his fingers unconsciously stroking the rim of the tea cup, and his eyes glanced at the arch from time to time.

    As a result, before Shen Nanchu showed up, Chu Yang came first.

    He watched the other person walk up to him step by step, stared at him and asked, "Where is the person?"

    Chu Yang took a seat next to him, picked up an empty cup from the table, poured himself a cup of tea, picked it up and took a sip, then said calmly: "Let's go. Two hours ago, she said she had figured it out. Let me tell you that I wish you a happy marriage."

    Su Mu waited for a while and heard nothing, so he asked: "No? So gentle?"

    Chu Yang looked at each other and said with a smile: "No, just this sentence, can I still deceive big brother?"

    Su Mu raised his eyebrows and said with a strange expression: "Have you figured it out? Do you believe it? From early morning to now, five or six hours, where has she gone? Why did she suddenly figure it out? If she didn't come to bite me twice, she would have scolded me dozens of times!"

    Chu Yang shrugged and grinned: "I don't believe it either, but that's what she said. She said that after wandering around the city, she found it boring, and she suddenly figured it out. But when she blessed you, her smile was wrong. It didn't mean anything good at first sight. Anyway, she really left. I watched her go down the mountain and guarded the intersection for more than an hour, but I didn't see her sneak back."

    Su Mu pondered for a moment and then asked, "Did you tell me where you were going?"

    Chu Yang shook his head and said: "No, he said that he would wander around the world, be content with whatever comes, and take care of himself wherever he goes. He also said that we would see each other again if we were destined. These were what he said when he left early in the morning... Oh, that's right!"

    As he spoke, he reached for his waist and took out a large animal skin bag from his storage bag and placed it on the ground. The bottom of the bag made a dull sound when it landed on the bluestone.

    "The seven hundred spirit stones were also given to you by me early in the morning. Later, before you could see her off at the top of the mountain, she suddenly turned around again and looked very angry. I thought she was going to make trouble with her elder brother, so I sent a message to remind her... Then she reappeared around the same time and left very simply."

    Su Mu looked down at the animal skin bag at his feet, pursed his lips and remained silent.

    Chu Yang glanced at him, picked up the teapot and filled it with tea, and said with a smile at the corner of his mouth: "I asked, she saved more than 1,300, half of it with you. I wanted to refuse for you, but she forced it on me and said she pitied you, a rubbish rookie, just like feeding the dog...cough~ Brother, I'm paraphrasing the exact words."

    Su Mu kicked his foot away, laughed and cursed: "Get out!"

    But he accidentally touched the wound, and he let out a hiss, then slowly exhaled, put away his joke, and sighed softly: "If there is a chance in the future, I will pay her back a hundred times!"

    Chu Yang nodded lightly, smiled and said: "On the way here, I have been thinking that this result is quite good. Sister Nan Chu is so smart and clever, and it is generally difficult to be bullied by others outside. If I stay, it was okay for the eldest brother to be single in the past, but now he is with Junior Sister Qi. With Sister Nan Chu's temper, if I see it a few more times, I will probably have an explosive mentality, and maybe it will really cause big trouble."

    Su Mu smiled knowingly, and the image of Shen Nanchu with his hands on his hips and swearing came to mind.

    After thinking for a while, he motioned to the bag on the ground with his eyes and said: "Put these seven hundred spirit stones with you. The more types of monsters, the better, and the rare ones are also needed. Two thousand yuan is definitely not enough."

    Chu Yang took a look and said, "I was about to tell my brother that you shouldn't be in a hurry to use it. The monsters and materials in the shop are too expensive and not cost-effective. I accepted the mission and went out to hunt and capture them."

    Su Mu asked: "Where to go? How long?"

    Chu Yang said: "We will leave for Ten Thousand Beast Mountain the day after tomorrow. It will take eight or nine months to go back and forth. If we are lucky, it may be faster. After I come back, I will go to other cities and towns. It will basically be enough for me to get started with body training."

    Without waiting for further questions, he took the initiative to elaborate on the situation and said: "The main mission this time is to find the 'Hundred Flower Spirit Snake Grass' and the second-order 'Cloud-Piercing Eagle', which are found outside Ten Thousand Beast Mountain. There are five of us in a team, one is on the fourth floor of the mid-stage foundation building, and the rest is on the third floor of the foundation building like me. We are all acquaintances, and this is not our first time. The difficulty of the task is moderate."

    Su Mu said seriously: "Then you have to pay attention to safety, be more cautious, and be careful about everything."

    Chu Yang smiled and said, "I know, brother, don't worry."

    Su Mu nodded slightly and said, "Then leave these seven hundred spirit stones here with me and stay for dinner later to try your sister-in-law's craftsmanship."

    After the words fell, the sound of footsteps came from the corridor. Qi Yunxi lowered his head slightly and walked a little slower than usual. He looked preoccupied. Only when he got closer did he realize that there was an extra person in the courtyard.

    But Chu Yang stood up first, raised his hands and greeted, "Junior Sister Qi."

    Qi Yunxi, who was wandering in the world, was stunned, and quickly returned the salute: "Senior Brother Chu!"

    She then smiled at Su Mu and ran into the house. When she entered the room, she turned to look at the two of them. She was suspicious that an Inner Sect Foundation Establishment disciple actually took the initiative to salute and greet her. He had never been so polite before and just nodded in greeting.

    Here, Chu Yang couldn't help but send a message: "Brother, Junior Sister Qi is a bit stupid. She is so weak. She won't be able to help you with anything you do in the future. She is much worse than Sister Nanchu."

    Su Mu twitched the corner of his mouth and rolled his eyes.

    After a while, Qi Xiyun came out with a small round table and placed it in front of the two of them. Then he put spiritual fruits, cakes, melon seeds and other food on the table from the storage bag. Then he took the teapot to the kitchen, made a new pot of tea, and refilled it for the two of them.
